name: Lawyer skills

subjectOf.text: The core lawyer characteristics and skillsets produced by the existing legal education and regulatory framework are incompatible with what the practice of law in the 21st century demands.
subjectOf.abstract: Key lawyer characteristics and lawyers' core skillsets in the existing legal education and regulatory framework are incompatible with the demands on lawyers of the 21st century.
subjectOf.citation: Mark Fenwick, Wulf A. Kaal, Erik P. M. Vermeulen, Legal Education in the Blockchain Revolution (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2939127
scope_conditions: existing law school curricula and bar regulatory frameworks
21st century practice conditions shaped by disruptive technology

subjectOf.text: Disruptive innovation in law renders obsolete many and probably most of the traditional legal skills and characteristics that law schools currently cultivate.
subjectOf.abstract: Yet, disruptive innovation in law9 obviates many if not most of the traditional legal skills and characteristics of traditional lawyers.
subjectOf.citation: Mark Fenwick, Wulf A. Kaal, Erik P. M. Vermeulen, Legal Education in the Blockchain Revolution (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2939127
scope_conditions: areas of practice exposed to disruptive innovation in law

subjectOf.text: The traditional legal tool kit worked adequately when innovation cycles were long, but where innovation is exponential it is regularly out of touch with the radically different needs of a decentralized world and often produces disastrous outcomes.
subjectOf.abstract: This approach might have worked adequately when innovation cycles were longer, but in a world where innovations occur exponentially, the traditional legal tool kit is regularly out of touch with the radically different needs of a decentralized world.
subjectOf.citation: Mark Fenwick, Wulf A. Kaal, Erik P. M. Vermeulen, Legal Education in the Blockchain Revolution (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2939127
scope_conditions: exponential rather than long innovation cycles
